run.name: Keep package installation unattended
run.command:
# These build machines are discarded after the job.
sudo install -d /etc/needrestart/conf.d
printf '%s\n' '$nrconf{restart} = "l";' | sudo tee /etc/needrestart/conf.d/99-qqq-ci.conf >/dev/null

original_yaml:
version: 2.1

orbs:
   qqq-orb: kingsrook/qqq-orb@0.6.8

commands:
   configure-package-install:
      steps:
         - run:
              name: Keep package installation unattended
              command: |
                 # These build machines are discarded after the job.
                 sudo install -d /etc/needrestart/conf.d
                 printf '%s\n' '$nrconf{restart} = "l";' | sudo tee /etc/needrestart/conf.d/99-qqq-ci.conf >/dev/null

workflows:
   test_only:
      jobs:
         - qqq-orb/mvn_test_only:
              pre-steps:
                 - configure-package-install
              context: [qqq-maven-registry-credentials]
              filters:
                 branches:
                    ignore: /(develop|release\/.*|hotfix\/.*)/

   publish_snapshot:
      jobs:
         - qqq-orb/mvn_publish:
              pre-steps:
                 - configure-package-install
              context: [qqq-maven-registry-credentials]
              branch_type: snapshot
              filters:
                 branches:
                    only: [develop]

   publish_release_candidate:
      jobs:
         - qqq-orb/mvn_publish:
              pre-steps:
                 - configure-package-install
              context: [qqq-maven-registry-credentials]
              branch_type: release_candidate
              filters:
                 branches:
                    only: [/release\/.*/]

   publish_release:
      jobs:
         - qqq-orb/mvn_publish:
              pre-steps:
                 - configure-package-install
              context: [qqq-maven-registry-credentials]
              branch_type: release
              filters:
                 branches:
                    ignore: /.*/
                 tags:
                    only: [/^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$/]

   publish_hotfix_release:
      jobs:
         - qqq-orb/mvn_publish:
              pre-steps:
                 - configure-package-install
              context: [qqq-maven-registry-credentials]
              branch_type: hotfix
              filters:
                 branches:
                    only: [/hotfix\/.*/]
